propositions: A code-review finding raised on one patchset and not re-emitted on the next reaches no consumer, causing non-deterministic recall and blocking recalls from surfaced findings.
Standing items must be classified by region hash (still-present, addressed, or withdrawn) against the prior payload's deps map to determine eligibility for carry-forward.
Carried findings are injected post-Pass-1 into the merge_findings step as a new optional standing_findings workflow input, preventing finders from seeing them.
The posture of a carried finding is clamped to its origin_decision (taken from the prior surfaced bucket), preventing carry-forward from raising a blocking decision.
Carry-forward is one-shot: an already-carried item (withdrawn state) is not carried again, and addressed findings (edited region) are dropped.
Per-item origin bucket (blocking/advisory) and revision are exposed by latest_code_review_result and stamped onto each standing object for audit and clamp enforcement.
